definition_zh: 搞糟；笨手笨脚地做；把事情弄坏
definition_en: to carry out a task clumsily or badly, spoiling it
core_image: 越帮越忙的手，把线团绕成一团乱麻
scene: 他自告奋勇修水管，结果拧爆了接头。The plumber bungled the simple repair and flooded the kitchen.
sceneCN: 这里 bungle 是「搞砸、笨拙地弄坏」（第 1 个义项：因笨拙而把事办糟）；句意是水暖工把简单的修理搞砸，厨房发了水。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -er 构成，义为「笨手笨脚的人，老是搞砸的人」
由现在分词转形容词，义为「笨拙的，老出错的」

senses.title: To spoil a task through clumsiness
senses.definition: to ruin a job by handling it clumsily or incompetently
senses.definitionCN: 因笨拙或无能而把工作搞砸
senses.example: They bungled the launch and lost the client.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把发布活动搞砸了，丢了客户。
senses.why: The Swedish source means to work clumsily; clumsy work spoils the thing itself.
senses.whyCN: 瑞典语源词本指笨拙干活，笨拙的活计必然毁掉成品。

senses.title: To act clumsily in general
senses.titleCN: 笨手笨脚；屡屡出错（不及物）
senses.definition: to do things in a habitually clumsy, botching way
senses.definitionCN: 做事一贯笨拙、经常出错
senses.example: He bungles whenever he touches tools.
senses.why: One spoiled task generalizes into a manner of working.
senses.whyCN: 一次搞砸推广成一贯的做派，动词由及物转不及物。

senses.title: A botched act or attempt
senses.definition: a spoiled piece of work resulting from clumsy handling
senses.definitionCN: 因笨拙处理而失败的活计或尝试
senses.example: The escape was a complete bungle.
senses.why: The action names its product: the botch itself.
senses.whyCN: 动作转指其产物，「搞砸」即「砸了的那件事」。

intro.en: Bungle is first recorded in the sixteenth century, probably borrowed from Swedish bunga, to work clumsily.
intro.cn: bungle 首见于十六世纪，一般认为借自瑞典语 bunga（笨拙地干活）。

items.en: Swedish bunga and related dialect words meant to languish or work badly.
items.cn: 瑞典语 bunga 及相关方言词指萎靡、干活糟糕。

items.en: bungle appears in Scots with the sense of acting awkwardly.
items.cn: 十六世纪苏格兰英语中 bungle 意为举止笨拙。

items.en: the verb spread through English for botching any task.
items.cn: 十六至十七世纪该动词传遍英语，泛指把事办砸。

items.en: bungler and bungling named the habitual botcher.
items.cn: 十八至十九世纪 bungler、bungling 指惯于出错之人。

items.en: bungle is common in news prose for official incompetence.
items.cn: 如今 bungle 常见于新闻文体，指官方办事无能。

note.en: Bungle rhymes with a small family of -le verbs and stands among the botching words.
note.cn: bungle 与一小族 -le 动词押韵，置身「搞砸」词汇群。

entries.definitionCN: 笨手笨脚者，bungle 的施动名词
笨拙的，bungle 的现在分词

entries.definition: a stopper for a cask; a throw
entries.definitionCN: 桶塞；扔，仅开头字母相同，词源无关
丛林，拼形相近，词源不同

entries.definition: to fail to catch or perform

normalIntro.en: Hear the clumsy thud in the middle: bun-GLE, a job dropped.
normalIntro.cn: 听词中间那记笨重的闷响：bun-GLE，活儿掉地上了。

normal.en: The Swedish source bunga means to work clumsily.
normal.cn: 瑞典语源词 bunga 意为笨拙干活。

normal.en: -le marks clumsy verbs: fumble, mumble, bungle.
Bungler is the person; bungling is the style.
Botch and bungle often appear together in criticism.
normal.cn: botch 与 bungle 在批评语中常连用。

normal.en: A bungled attempt is the standard news collocation.
normal.cn: a bungled attempt 是新闻标配搭配。

abstract.en: Watch icing slide off a cake you tilt too far.
abstract.cn: 看你把蛋糕倾斜过头，糖霜整片滑落。

abstract.en: Hear a key snap inside a lock you forced.
abstract.cn: 听钥匙断在你硬拧的锁芯里。

abstract.en: Feel wet paint smear under a hasty palm.
abstract.cn: 感受湿漆在你匆忙的手掌下晕开。

examples.en: The agency bungled the evacuation plans.
examples.cn: 该机构把撤离方案搞得一团糟。

examples.en: He bungled his opening line and lost the room.
examples.cn: 他开场白就说砸了，冷了全场。

examples.en: Years of bungling left the project millions over budget.
examples.cn: 连年失误使项目预算超支数百万。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「帮狗」——他想「帮」忙却越帮越乱，像条拆家的「狗」，把事彻底搞砸。

root: bungle 首见于十六世纪苏格兰英语，一般认为借自瑞典语 bunga（萎靡、笨拙干活），属斯堪的纳维亚借词；词根与表笨拙动作的 -le 动词一族（fumble、mumble）风格一致，无古典拉丁词根。

sensesIntro.en: Clumsy handling first ruins the task, then names the clumsy manner, and finally the ruined result itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 笨拙的手法先毁掉差事，继而指称笨拙的做派，最后转指那件砸了的成品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: helping hands that unravel the ball of wool.
core.cn: 核心意象：越帮越乱、把毛线团扯散的手。

branches.en: the whole affair was a bungle

intro.en: Bungle wears the frequentative -le suffix that marks clumsy repeated action.
intro.cn: bungle 带着表「笨拙反复动作」的 -le 后缀。

latinIntro.en: The stem is Scandinavian; no Latin relative exists.
latinIntro.cn: 词干出自斯堪的纳维亚语，拉丁语中并无亲缘。

items.exampleCN: 方言中的 bunga（如词源所示）

items.meaningCN: 表反复（常笨拙）动作的后缀

items.meaning: to bungle a line or act
a stupid mistake; to err blindly
